Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a minimum amount of operating budget reserves.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring a minimum amount of operating budgetreserves; adding a new section to chapter 43.88 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds a healthy budgetreserve helps provide stability to the state budget process by reducingthe likelihood of tax increases or severe budget cuts during economicdownturns and helps guard against excessive spending during goodeconomic times. The legislature further finds economists conclude ahealthy state government budget reserve includes at least five percentof budgeted expenditures.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.88 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governor may not propose, and the legislature may notenact, any near general fund operating budget that does not set asideat least five percent of near general fund budgeted expenditures as areserve amount. p. 1 HB 2562 (2) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply: (a) "Near general fund" means the state general fund, pensionfunding stabilization account, the education legacy trust accountcreated in RCW 83.100.230, and the Washington opportunity pathwaysaccount created in RCW 28B.76.526; (b) "Operating budget" means the omnibus operating appropriationsact, or any combination of acts that make appropriations for operatingbudget purposes; and (c) "Reserve amount" means the unrestricted ending fund balance andthe budget stabilization account created in RCW 43.79.490.
